tei:div.tei:p: tshar bcu gsog dus/ bde gshegs 'dus pa dril rdung*/ phyogs bzhi la ḍā ru med/ byin 'bebs hrug 'don/ chos dbyings= dril rdung*/ de yi phyi rim= ḍā ru dkrol/ spyan 'dren mgor/ 'ur/ bstod pa mthar/ mchod bstod la mchod rol med/ sprul pa'i= nas dril rdung kho nas/ mchod bstod dril bsil/ bh+rum̐ḥsnod kyi= nas ḍa ru dkrol/ spyan 'dren mgor/ 'ur/ bstod pa mthar/ 'ur bdun gsum/ mchod bstod dril bsil/ mdun bskyed/ dril tshag mchod bstod dril bsil/ sku ni mi 'gyur= phyag 'tshal= dril tshag hoḥ dgongs su gsol= rmad byung= ḍā ru/ bstsal du gsol/ 'ur/ chos dbyings mdangs la= mthar bcad rgya dril tshag yig brgya/ dam tshig can= mchod bshags 'dra/ tshogs bsgral bstab khrob rdung mi dgos/ 'ur/ bstan dgra= lha mi sbrel ba la mi bcad/ 'ur bdun/ nam bcad/ pad+ma'i rgyal po= dril tshag kho nas/ rgya pa'i= lhug lhag ma byin rlabs/ ḍā 'ur/ lhag ma mthar/ 'ur bdun gsum/ tshogs 'khor/ maṇ+ḍal/ ye shes= dril chag bdag nyid rdo rje= dril tshag nṛ badz+ra= mi dgos/ sangs rgyas bden pa= 'dod yon= dril tshag bla mas ḍā ru bcad/ bden stobs/ 'ur/ phyi snod/ rak+ṣa hūm̐/ bcad/ rnal 'byor= dril tshag bcom ldan dril tshag ḍā 'ur/ mchod rol/ khrus kyi= dril tshag kho nas/ gyur cig dbang bshad/ maṇ+ḍal/ e ma/ dril tshag ye shes lnga la= dril tshag ḍā 588) 'ur/ mthar/ 'ur bdun/ bkra shis yan dril tshag nyon cig= dril tshag phyin drug sbrel/ me sbar gzhung rgyug ka ka ni= phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba= rtsa sngags/ bho dhi= na ma sarba= mchod rol/ chos sku nam mkha sa bstod/ gang yang= ltung bshags/ bsam lhun/ ༈ bsdus pa'i lugs/ bde gshegs rgyal ba= ma hā sarba= spyan 'dren mgor bum bskyed sprad/ bdag bskyed spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i mtha'/ thugs kar= dril tshag rgya mtshor gsal/ kun bzang yab yum= bhau dhi/ nṛ yig mchod bstod/ dril bsil/ rigs brgya rigs lnga tshigs bcad gnyis/

dam tshig pa= man dril tshag mdun bskyed/ mchod bstod/ dril bsil dge bsngo/ phyag 'tshal skye med rnam dag= hūm̐/ rmad byung= dril tshag rgyal ba zhi khro= tshag bla med gsang= tshag dkon mchog gsum gyi= gzugs kyi= tshag pad+ma'i theg chen= hūm̐/ dur khrod= tshig lhug dor/ e ma ke ri= dpa' bo= tshag slar/ shig 'bru gsum dpal gyi= tshogs 'khor/ swa bhā wa= 'gugs pa tshigs bcad/ a ka ro= sarba= gcig sum bha= gcig hrī/ 'dod yon= ḍā ru/ bla ma'i= mi dgos/ sum bha= 'ur/ badz+ra kro dha= bcad/ nyon cig= tshag thugs mchog= gcig ḍā ru/ mchod rol/ ji ltar= rgyal ba'i sku gzugs= de dag= sna tshogs= rgyal ba zhi khro= sang gha ya= chos sku nam mkha'= 'dod yon= gsum/ rigs drug tu skye ba'i sgo chod par= gnyis/ tram gu ru= e ma sangs rgyas= swa bhā wa= stong pa'i= ḍā 'ur/ dpe med= 589) tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ bcad/ hrīḥ bum pa= rtsa sngags tshig lhug 'don/ bh+yo bh+yo/ mthar/ bum pa lha'i= sngon tshe/ chos sku nam mkha'= nyon cig= a ka ro= gzugs sgra gcig= 'di ni pha rol phyin drug zas/ /phyin drug rnam par dag pas= 'dod yon nam mkha'i= e ma zhing khams 'di= nas/ bla mas/ phaṭa gcig pad+ma 'dam gyi= rgyal ba zhi khro= kaṃ ka= phyogs bcu'-i= gang yang= yig brgya/ mchod rol/ ltung bshags/ bsam lhun/ de 'dra tshar brgyad/ ༈ tshar bcu pa la/ ye nas rang grol= dril tshag bde gshegs 'dus pa= gcig bla ma'i byin rlabs= hūṃ hūṃ/ phyi snod= dril tshag hring hring*/ byin 'bebs/ ngo mtshar= dril tshag ma hā pad+ma= mchod bstod/ ma bcos sprul= tshag ḍā 'ur/ spyan 'dren nas/ bstod pa'i mthar/ 'ur bdun gsum/ mchod bstod/ ye shes pa= snod kyi= dril tshag chos dbyings= dril tshag ḍā 'ur/ spyan 'dren nas/ bstod/ mthar/ 'ur bdun gsum/ nad gdon= sogs/ mchod bstod rol/ ma bcos= dril tshag dge bsngo yan/ skye med chos dbyings= che chung gnyis/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor= rmad byung= dril tshag chos dbyings= dril tshag

rgyal ba zhi khro= bla med gsang= dril tshag bden chung*/ gzugs kyi= dril tshag pad+ma'i= sogs tshangs mo dril tshag bka' gsang= sogs mar 'gros/ lhag ma byin rlabs 'ur/ lhag gdangs/ 'ur gsum/ bdun gsum/ tshogs 'khor/ swa bha wa= 'gugs pa tshigs bcad gcig a ka ro= sarba= gcig sum bha= gcig 'dod yon= dril tshag bla ma ḍā ru/ sum bha= 'ur/ rak+ṣa= bcad/ nyon cig= dril tshag mar 'gres rgyas pa/ ḍā ru 'ur/ mchod rol/ 590) khrus kyi= ji ltar= 'di ni= rgyal ba'i sku gzugs= de dag= nyon cig= sa gha la= sangs rgyas thams cad= chos sku nam mkha'= thog ma med= phyag 'tshal ba dang= a ka ro= 'dod yon= dril tshag mar chas/ lha ru= sa gzhi= e ma= dril tshag ma nor cig swa bhā wa= ḍā 'ur/ sngon gyi= dpe med= 'ur bdun/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ e ma sangs rgyas= kye/ rigs kyi bu= mnyam 'don/ bum pa stong gsal= sku bum pa'i= mnyam 'don rtsa sngags sbyar/ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad= rdzas rtags brgyad/ chos sku nam mkha'= nyon cig tshe 'das= byin rlabs tshe 'das= sogs rgyas pa/ sbyin pa'i= sogs tshar dang po ltar/ 'dod yon nam mkha'i= e ma tshe 'das= dal 'don/ zhing khams 'di nas bye'u sha med= bla mas/ tshe 'das bde ba can du= pad+ma 'dam gyi= nub tha ma yin na me thab bskyed pa/ rgyal ba zhi khro= rang gdangs/ yig rgya/ kaṃ ka= me sbar/ chos skyong srung ma= a li ka li= ma ma ko ling= 'a a sha sa/ bar/ skye ba kun tu= rnam dag dge ba'i= phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba= ltung bshags/ bzang spyod/ gsol ka byin rlabs/ ḍā 'ur/ bskal pa'i me 'bar= chos skyong srung ma= ḍā 'ur/ sngon tshe slob dpon= sangs rgyas zhing= ḍā ru dkrol/ thabs shes sgyu ma'i= bcad/ 'gugs pa bcad/ 'ur/ thog med dus nas= brtan ma chen po= 'ur/ bdun gsum/ bro 'gugs/ bcad/ 'ur/ gtor snod kha yar/ rang snang= dngos grub/ mchod bstod/ rol/ bshags pa= yig brgya gsum/ dbyangs gsal/ 'dir ni= ye dharma= bkra shis ji rigs/ gzhung gi bkra shis rigs/
'dus dang 'dus byas= bdag dang dam tshig= legs so/ bsod nams 'di yi= rin chen dge tshogs= phan bde= sogs//
